title: Lineage
description: Where an event came from: who made it, through what, when, why, as part of which command and in reaction to what, with whose approval, and in what version-control state. Every event troupe records carries it. It is left out of the event's content hash, so two clones that make the same change agree on the event's id.

via.title: Via
via.description: The surface the event came through. A closed set: a new surface is a schema change.

at.description: When troupe recorded the event, in UTC.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, in the actor's words. null when none was given: absent is explicit, never a missing field.

change.title: Change
change.description: The correlation id: minted by the command that started this, and carried by every event that follows from it, reactions included.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Who approved the event, and in which role. Empty when nobody had to.

hash.title: Content hash
hash.description: sha256: and the lowercase hex SHA-256 digest.

ulid.title: ULID
ulid.description: A ULID: 26 characters of Crockford base32, sortable by time.

timestamp.title: Time
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC, with milliseconds and Z.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who made the event. Never null: where nobody can be known, such as a hand edit to a file, the kind is an explicit unknown.

source.description: The identity source that resolved the actor, such as env, vcs or os-login, or troupe for an agent troupe assigned.

cause.title: Cause
cause.description: What made the event happen: the command that recorded it directly (its id is the change id), or the event it reacts to. Never null.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: Where the actor whose run recorded this event ran, and whether troupe enforced its declared effects there. null for an event recorded outside a stage, such as one a person's command recorded. An unenforced stage names the policy setting, and the source of its value, that allowed the run; an enforced one names none.

setting.description: The policy setting that allowed the run, such as allow_unenforced_local_stage.

source.description: Where the setting's value came from, such as env.

stageName.title: Stage name
stageName.description: The name a stage is registered under, such as local.

vcs.title: Version-control state
vcs.description: The state the event was made in. branch is null when HEAD is detached or the adapter has no branches; head is null before the first commit or without version control. source is set only for an event made from a file.

path.description: The file, relative to the theatre, with / separators. Never a host path.

before.description: The file's content hash before the change; null when it didn't exist.

after.description: The file's content hash after the change; null when it no longer exists.
